name: EDC Sticky
summary: Everyday-carry companion: clock, alarm, world time, calculator, level, ruler, QR cards – useful alone, smart with the app.
description: Custom firmware plus an Android companion app. On its own the Sticky keeps working for days: alarm, world time, timer, calculator and unit converter, spirit level, ruler (mm/inch), QR cards, a scribble pad, single-stroke handwriting, voice notes buffered on microSD and a trip/climate logger. The app adds offline speech-to-text, weather, new pages and sync. Pages turn with the device (motion sensor) and follow a Braun ET66-inspired design. Settings on the device: 12/24 h, metric/US, set the clock.

compatibility.notes: Needs a microSD card. Pages, widgets and settings are set up once by the Android companion app (APK in the GitHub releases); afterwards the Sticky works without the phone.

assets.previewAlt: reTerminal Sticky with the EDC firmware: timer page in portrait with Braun-style keys on e-paper

notes.title: Back up the factory firmware first
notes.description: It contains device-specific data: esptool read-flash 0 0x2000000 backup.bin. Restore with write-flash 0 backup.bin.

notes.title: Companion app
notes.description: Install the Android app from the GitHub releases and connect once: it sets the clock and copies pages, widgets and settings to the microSD card.

notes.title: First boot without the app
notes.description: Shows a card with a QR code to the project page. Keys: AI = Home, ▲/▼ = pages, ▲+▼ = help.
